# Overview

This document contains the R code used for the main analyses reported in the manuscript on diagnostic practices for childhood asthma among Swiss physicians. Individual-level survey data are not included in the public repository to protect participant confidentiality.

# 1. Setup

```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary)
library(broom)
```

# 2. Load analytical dataset

```{r}
# The analytical dataset is not publicly available.
# The code assumes that data2.csv is stored in the project root directory.
data2 <- read.csv(here::here("data2.csv"))
```

# 3. Define physician groups

```{r}
data2 <- data2 %>%
  mutate(
    primary_ped_spe_other = case_when(
      phyq_q1_sp %in% c(1, 2) & physq_3_workplace == 1 ~ "Primary care paediatricians",
      phyq_q1_sp %in% c(1, 2) & physq_3_workplace %in% c(2, 3) ~ "Hospital paediatricians",
      phyq_q1_sp %in% c(3, 4, 13, 14) ~ "Paediatric specialists",
      phyq_q1_sp %in% c(9, 10, 11, 12) ~ "Adult specialists",
      phyq_q1_sp %in% c(5, 6, 7, 8) ~ "Other physicians",
      TRUE ~ "Other physicians"
    ),
    primary_ped_spe_other = factor(
      primary_ped_spe_other,
      levels = c(
        "Primary care paediatricians",
        "Hospital paediatricians",
        "Paediatric specialists",
        "Adult specialists",
        "Other physicians"
      )
    )
  )
```

# 4. Create analysis variables

```{r}
data2 <- data2 %>%
  mutate(
    children_per_month = case_when(
      phyq_q5_permonth == 2 ~ "1–5 children/month",
      phyq_q5_permonth == 3 ~ "6–14 children/month",
      phyq_q5_permonth == 4 ~ "15–29 children/month",
      phyq_q5_permonth %in% c(5, 6, 7) ~ "≥30 children/month",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    new_asthma = case_when(
      phyq_q6_new.factor %in% c(
        "≥ 30 neue Diagnosen/Monat",
        "20-29 neue Diagnosen/Monat",
        "10-19 neue Diagnosen/Monat"
      ) ~ "≥10/month",
      phyq_q6_new.factor == "4-9 neue Diagnosen/Monat" ~ "4–9/month",
      phyq_q6_new.factor == "1-3 neue Diagnosen/Monat" ~ "1–3/month",
      phyq_q6_new.factor == "Keine" ~ "None",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    age_group_comb30 = case_when(
      phyq_30_age %in% c(1, 2) ~ "Under 40 years",
      phyq_30_age == 3 ~ "40–49 years",
      phyq_30_age == 4 ~ "50–59 years",
      phyq_30_age == 5 ~ "≥60 years",
      phyq_30_age == 6 ~ "Prefer not to say",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    workplace = case_when(
      physq_3_workplace == 1 ~ "Practice",
      physq_3_workplace == 2 ~ "Hospital",
      physq_3_workplace == 3 ~ "Practice and hospital",
      physq_3_workplace == 4 ~ "Neither",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    phyq_q2_work = as.numeric(phyq_q2_work),
    clinical_time_group = case_when(
      phyq_q2_work >= 90 ~ "Full time",
      phyq_q2_work < 90 ~ "Part-time",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    swiss_2024 = case_when(
      phyq_27_consult_guide == 1 & phyq_27_2_guide___1 == 1 ~ "Yes",
      phyq_27_consult_guide == 1 & phyq_27_2_guide___1 == 0 ~ "No",
      phyq_27_consult_guide == 0 ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    ers_2021 = case_when(
      phyq_27_consult_guide == 1 & phyq_27_2_guide___3 == 1 ~ "Yes",
      phyq_27_consult_guide == 1 & phyq_27_2_guide___3 == 0 ~ "No",
      phyq_27_consult_guide == 0 ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    gina_2023 = case_when(
      phyq_27_consult_guide == 1 & phyq_27_2_guide___4 == 1 ~ "Yes",
      phyq_27_consult_guide == 1 & phyq_27_2_guide___4 == 0 ~ "No",
      phyq_27_consult_guide == 0 ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

# 5. Physician characteristics

```{r}
table1 <- data2 %>%
  select(
    primary_ped_spe_other,
    phyq_28_lang.factor,
    phyq_29_gender.factor,
    age_group_comb30,
    workplace,
    clinical_time_group,
    children_per_month,
    new_asthma,
    swiss_2024,
    ers_2021,
    gina_2023
  ) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = primary_ped_spe_other,
    statistic = all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)",
    digits = all_categorical() ~ 0,
    missing = "no"
  ) %>%
  add_ci(method = everything() ~ "wilson") %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Characteristic**") %>%
  bold_labels()

table1
```

# 6. Availability and use of first-line diagnostic tests

```{r}
data2 <- data2 %>%
  mutate(
    spiro_use = case_when(
      phyq_q7_2_spiro_often == 1 ~ "Use in almost all (>90%)",
      phyq_q7_2_spiro_often == 2 ~ "Mostly used (>50%)",
      phyq_q7_2_spiro_often %in% c(3, 4) ~ "Infrequently used (<50%)",
      phyq_q7_2_spiro_often == 5 ~ "Available but never used",
      phyq_q7_spiro == 1 ~ "Use but frequency missing",
      phyq_q7_spiro == 0 ~ "Not available",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    bdr_use = case_when(
      phyq_q9_2_brd_often == 1 ~ "Use in almost all (>90%)",
      phyq_q9_2_brd_often == 2 ~ "Mostly used (>50%)",
      phyq_q9_2_brd_often %in% c(3, 4) ~ "Infrequently used (<50%)",
      phyq_q9_2_brd_often == 5 ~ "Available but never used",
      phyq_9_brd == 1 ~ "Use but frequency missing",
      phyq_9_brd == 0 ~ "Not available",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    feno_use = case_when(
      phyq_11_4_feno_often == 1 ~ "Use in almost all (>90%)",
      phyq_11_4_feno_often == 2 ~ "Mostly used (>50%)",
      phyq_11_4_feno_often %in% c(3, 4) ~ "Infrequently used (<50%)",
      phyq_11_4_feno_often == 5 ~ "Available but never used",
      phyq_11_feno == 1 ~ "Use but frequency missing",
      phyq_11_feno == 0 ~ "Not available",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

first_line_table <- data2 %>%
  select(primary_ped_spe_other, spiro_use, bdr_use, feno_use) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = primary_ped_spe_other,
    statistic = all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)",
    missing = "no",
    label = list(
      spiro_use ~ "Spirometry",
      bdr_use ~ "Bronchodilator response",
      feno_use ~ "FeNO"
    )
  ) %>%
  bold_labels()

first_line_table
```

# 7. Barriers to first-line testing among primary care paediatricians

```{r}
pcp_data <- data2 %>%
  filter(primary_ped_spe_other == "Primary care paediatricians")

summarise_checkbox_reasons <- function(df, prefix, labels) {
  denominator <- n_distinct(df$record_id)

  df %>%
    mutate(across(starts_with(prefix), as.character)) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with(prefix),
      names_to = "reason",
      values_to = "selected"
    ) %>%
    filter(selected == "1") %>%
    mutate(
      reason_code = stringr::str_remove(reason, fixed(prefix)),
      reason = recode(reason_code, !!!labels)
    ) %>%
    count(reason, sort = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(percentage = 100 * n / denominator)
}

reason_labels <- c(
  "1" = "No need for the test",
  "2" = "Not enough staff",
  "3" = "Not enough time",
  "4" = "Difficult cooperation with school children",
  "5" = "Parents reject the test",
  "6" = "Results are difficult to interpret in children",
  "7" = "Poor reimbursement by insurance",
  "8" = "Device is too expensive",
  "9" = "Other reason"
)

spirometry_barriers <- pcp_data %>%
  filter(phyq_q7_spiro == 0) %>%
  summarise_checkbox_reasons(
    prefix = "phyq_q7_nospiro___",
    labels = reason_labels
  )

feno_barriers <- pcp_data %>%
  filter(phyq_11_feno == 0) %>%
  summarise_checkbox_reasons(
    prefix = "phyq_11_1_feno_whyno___",
    labels = reason_labels
  )

spirometry_barriers
feno_barriers
```

# 8. Referral practices among primary care paediatricians

The following analyses are restricted to primary care paediatricians. All percentages and comparisons are calculated directly from the analytical dataset. 

## 8.1 Referral frequency and destination

```{r}
referral_summary <- pcp_data %>%
  select(
    `Referral destination` = phyq_26_1_ref_where.factor,
    `Referral frequency` = phyq_26_per_ref.factor
  ) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    type = all_categorical() ~ "categorical",
    statistic = all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)",
    missing = "no"
  ) %>%
  modify_caption(
    "**Referral destination and frequency among primary care paediatricians**"
  ) %>%
  bold_labels()

referral_summary
```

## 8.2 Reasons for referral

```{r}
referral_reason_labels <- c(
  "1" = "Confirm asthma diagnosis / rule out differentials",
  "2" = "Perform unavailable tests",
  "3" = "Severe or uncontrolled symptoms",
  "4" = "Children with comorbidities",
  "5" = "Complex social/family situation",
  "6" = "Intensify therapy",
  "7" = "Reduce or discontinue therapy",
  "8" = "Problems with compliance/adherence",
  "9" = "At family's request",
  "10" = "Other"
)

referral_reasons <- pcp_data %>%
  summarise_checkbox_reasons(
    prefix = "phyq_26_2_reason_ref___",
    labels = referral_reason_labels
  )

referral_reasons
```

## 8.3 Referral practices according to spirometry access

```{r}
pcp_referral <- pcp_data %>%
  mutate(
    spirometry_access = factor(
      phyq_q7_spiro,
      levels = c(1, 0),
      labels = c("Access to spirometry", "No access to spirometry")
    )
  )

referral_by_spiro <- pcp_referral %>%
  select(
    spirometry_access,
    `Referral destination` = phyq_26_1_ref_where.factor,
    `Referral frequency` = phyq_26_per_ref.factor
  ) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = spirometry_access,
    type = all_categorical() ~ "categorical",
    statistic = all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)",
    missing = "no"
  ) %>%
  add_p(
    test = list(
      `Referral destination` ~ "chisq.test",
      `Referral frequency` ~ "chisq.test"
    )
  ) %>%
  modify_header(label = "**Characteristic**") %>%
  modify_caption(
    "**Referral practices according to access to spirometry**"
  ) %>%
  bold_labels()

referral_by_spiro
```

## 8.4 Reasons for referral according to spirometry access

```{r}
referral_reasons_by_spiro <- pcp_referral %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("phyq_26_2_reason_ref___"), as.character)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("phyq_26_2_reason_ref___"),
    names_to = "reason",
    values_to = "selected"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    reason_code = stringr::str_remove(
      reason,
      fixed("phyq_26_2_reason_ref___")
    ),
    reason = recode(reason_code, !!!referral_reason_labels),
    selected = selected == "1"
  )

# Number of PCPs in each spirometry-access group
group_denominators <- pcp_referral %>%
  filter(!is.na(spirometry_access)) %>%
  count(spirometry_access, name = "denominator")

# Counts and percentages for each referral reason
referral_reason_comparison <- referral_reasons_by_spiro %>%
  filter(selected, !is.na(spirometry_access)) %>%
  count(reason, spirometry_access, name = "n") %>%
  complete(
    reason,
    spirometry_access,
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  left_join(group_denominators, by = "spirometry_access") %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * n / denominator)

referral_reason_comparison

# Chi-square or Fisher's exact test for each referral reason
referral_reason_tests <- referral_reasons_by_spiro %>%
  filter(!is.na(spirometry_access)) %>%
  group_by(reason) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    tab <- table(.x$spirometry_access, .x$selected)

    if (nrow(tab) < 2 || ncol(tab) < 2) {
      return(tibble(p_value = NA_real_, test = NA_character_))
    }

    expected <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab)$expected)

    if (any(expected < 5)) {
      tibble(
        p_value = fisher.test(tab)$p.value,
        test = "Fisher's exact test"
      )
    } else {
      tibble(
        p_value = chisq.test(tab, correct = FALSE)$p.value,
        test = "Chi-square test"
      )
    }
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

referral_reason_tests
```

# 10. Factors associated with spirometry access among primary care paediatricians

```{r}
data_pc <- data2 %>%
  filter(primary_ped_spe_other == "Primary care paediatricians") %>%
  mutate(
    # Verify against the final manuscript analysis before public release.
    spirometry_access = as.numeric(phyq_q7_spiro == 1),
    language_binary = case_when(
      phyq_28_lang.factor == "Deutsch" ~ "German region",
      phyq_28_lang.factor %in% c("Französisch", "Italienisch") ~ "French/Italian region",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    gender_group = case_when(
      phyq_29_gender.factor == "Männlich" ~ "Male",
      phyq_29_gender.factor == "Weiblich" ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    children_per_month_grouped = case_when(
      children_per_month == "1–5 children/month" ~ "1–5 children/month",
      children_per_month %in% c(
        "6–14 children/month",
        "15–29 children/month",
        "≥30 children/month"
      ) ~ ">6 children/month",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    new_asthma_grouped = case_when(
      new_asthma == "None" ~ "None",
      new_asthma %in% c("1–3/month", "4–9/month", "≥10/month") ~ "≥1/month",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(language_binary),
    !is.na(gender_group),
    !is.na(age_group_comb30),
    age_group_comb30 != "Prefer not to say"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    language_binary = relevel(factor(language_binary), ref = "German region"),
    gender_group = relevel(factor(gender_group), ref = "Female"),
    age_group_comb30 = relevel(factor(age_group_comb30), ref = "Under 40 years"),
    clinical_time_group = relevel(factor(clinical_time_group), ref = "Part-time"),
    children_per_month_grouped = relevel(
      factor(children_per_month_grouped),
      ref = "1–5 children/month"
    ),
    new_asthma_grouped = relevel(factor(new_asthma_grouped), ref = "None"),
    swiss_2024 = relevel(factor(swiss_2024), ref = "No"),
    ers_2021 = relevel(factor(ers_2021), ref = "No"),
    gina_2023 = relevel(factor(gina_2023), ref = "No")
  )
```

## 10.1 Univariable analyses

```{r}
predictors <- c(
  "language_binary",
  "gender_group",
  "age_group_comb30",
  "clinical_time_group",
  "children_per_month_grouped",
  "new_asthma_grouped",
  "swiss_2024",
  "ers_2021",
  "gina_2023"
)

results_univariable <- map_dfr(
  predictors,
  function(v) {
    glm(
      reformulate(v, response = "spirometry_access"),
      data = data_pc,
      family = binomial
    ) %>%
      broom::tidy(exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
      filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
      mutate(variable = v)
  }
)

results_univariable
```

## 10.2 Multivariable analysis

```{r}
model_spiro <- glm(
  spirometry_access ~
    language_binary +
    gender_group +
    age_group_comb30 +
    clinical_time_group +
    children_per_month_grouped +
    new_asthma_grouped +
    swiss_2024 +
    ers_2021 +
    gina_2023,
  data = data_pc,
  family = binomial
)

results_multivariable <- broom::tidy(
  model_spiro,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  conf.int = TRUE
) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)")

results_multivariable
```

## 10.3 Regression table

```{r}
tbl_regression_spiro <- tbl_regression(
  model_spiro,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  label = list(
    language_binary ~ "Language region",
    gender_group ~ "Gender",
    age_group_comb30 ~ "Age group",
    clinical_time_group ~ "Clinical workload",
    children_per_month_grouped ~ "Children with asthma seen per month",
    new_asthma_grouped ~ "New asthma diagnoses per month",
    swiss_2024 ~ "Swiss 2024 guideline consultation",
    ers_2021 ~ "ERS 2021 guideline consultation",
    gina_2023 ~ "GINA guideline consultation"
  )
)

tbl_regression_spiro
```
